# The checks of the CI image job against published images (D-168 (7), D-173), one per line:
#   upgrade <image>   a data folder written by that image is upgraded by the new image with the
#                     same figures (the previous supported release: 1.0.0-rc.2, the first after
#                     the baseline revision 1000)
#   refuse <image>    a data folder written by that preview image is refused by the new image,
#                     untouched (0.9.0 and 1.0.0-rc.1 share the preview schema)
# Each image is pinned by its digest. Update after each release (docs/development.md, "Cutting a
# release"). Empty lines and lines starting with # are skipped.
refuse ghcr.io/horo86/portfolio-tracker:0.9.0@sha256:aaa3bf7f00590df10f077a80a584b96cddcba3b0ae3c503f0a2dd196425a407a
upgrade ghcr.io/horo86/portfolio-tracker:1.0.0-rc.2@sha256:65d9fe31e7dab9fc5b31a6aa700acdbc85ebdbfd7e65a0123e7f5ce992ac21de
